details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K7, K8, and K9. K1 is fully covered with revenue, EBITDA, net profit, and portfolio growth. K2 is covered with the revenue breakdown across business lines. K3 and K4 are covered with the mention of installment loans in European markets and smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda. K5 is covered with the mention of Tanzania expansion. K7 and K8 are covered with the bond tap and bond issuance details. K9 is covered with the dividend distribution. However, K6 (AI voice agents pilot), K10 (impairment expense), K11 (regulatory challenge in Moldova), and K12 (post-reporting period funding) are entirely missing, leading to a 'Generally yes' score due to substantial but not complete coverage of high-importance criteria.

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S2 contains an apparent numerical inconsistency: it states revenues of 250.0 million euros represent a 15.4% increase compared to 2016.6 million euros reported in 2024. The figure '2016.6 million euros' is not a plausible numeric value for a financial metric (it reads like a date followed by a decimal), creating a logical gap in the comparability assertion. However, this may reflect a transcription error rather than an internal contradiction, as the rest of the summary shows consistent year-on-year comparisons.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is largely coherent with clear progression through financial highlights, operational developments, and capital management achievements. All comparisons (net portfolio growth, adjusted EBITDA, profit figures, loan issuances) are internally consistent and logically connected. The only notable issue is in S2 where the prior-year revenue figure appears malformed ('2016.6 million euros'), creating a logical gap in the growth calculation assertion.
